articles.summary: Following Hurricane Nolo, Bank of Hawai‘i will reopen its branches on Hawai‘i Island for normal operating hours starting tomorrow, Monday, Sept. 28. Weekdays: 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. Saturdays: 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. Sundays: closed
articles.title: Bank of Hawai‘i to Reopen its Hawai‘i Island Branches Following Hurricane Nolo
